Dubs Mint Menus — Godot UI port (private development copy)
Original author: Dubwise
Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1446523594
Repository: https://github.com/Dubwise56/Dubs-Mint-Menus
Input: user-provided 1.7/Assemblies/DubsMintMenus.dll
SHA-256: 155b7762c1fb9ff927d7c5d9c561d97baf0950b34e91e0e55e8ec9180707ae2f

MenuLogic/MintMenuLogic.cs adapts the search predicates, stable nullable-stat ordering
and pinned-category ordering inspected with ILSpy 9.1.0.7988. Godot controls and
NoDwarf definition adapters are separate implementations. The original DLL is not bundled. Textures/ViewGrid.png, ViewList.png, Pin.png,
az.png, MenuSett.png and MintSearch.png are copied from the supplied mod. Decompiled inspection files remain in .local.

ArchitectInterface/CatalogLayout/MintWindow translate the architect window
coordinates, grid header, category list, search toolbar and information card
from MainTabWindow_MintArchitect. ProductionBrowser translates the adjacent
order/list/info arrangement of Patch_BillStack_DoListing. The production UI now follows the user-supplied bill-list and bill-details
screenshots. Count/maintain/forever, worker and material constraints are
implemented against NoDwarf simulation. A session clipboard copies bill settings.

The supplied package contained no license file. This notice records provenance,
not a grant of redistribution rights. Resolve permission before distributing
third-party-derived implementation beyond this private development copy.
